name: kubectl panel
tagline: the kubectl commands for what you are looking at
author: K8s Dockside
description: A panel on every Pod, Deployment and Service that lists the kubectl commands for that object: get, describe, logs, exec, port-forward, rollout and scale, filled in from the object itself and ready to paste. Every line names its cluster with --context, so a command copied from one tab cannot run against another; untick the box at the top of the panel to leave it off. Open any Pod, Deployment or Service to see it.
